query:
UPDATE team_members
        SET status = 'inactive', updated_at = NOW()
        WHERE user_id = $1 AND company_id = $2
        AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM team_members tm
            WHERE tm.user_id = $3 AND tm.company_id = $2
            AND tm.status = 'active' AND tm.can_manage_team = true
        )
